source_tokens.text: "CLAIM-004 (origin: Faith Friday 'shorting complexity', 2025-09-19; informed by AcadeResearch 2026 cohort): as enterprises add AI, complexity and inefficiency will rise before they fall - AI-adopter overhead ratios (G&A plus R&D as percent of revenue) will expand in the investment phase before contracting. Falsifier: AI-adopter overhead ratios contract immediately at scale, or no AI-adopting enterprise shows an investment-phase overhead step-up"
